column1: # The routes of the proofs in the three papers: which numbered results each proof uses.
# No author TeX exists for two of the papers, so this was written by hand from the PDFs and publisher XML, and
# checked against them; `route_check.py extract` could not be used. All labels are assigned here and appear in
# the docstrings of the Lean results. Columns: label, environment, the paper proves it (1/0), results used.
# ECToBlob (bioRxiv v1). Equations are rows because later proofs use them.
# TOB-QMC (bioRxiv v5). Unnumbered results proved in running text are rows with labels assigned here.
# TINNiK (Algorithms Mol. Biol. 2024). Labels of unnumbered statements of Appendix C are assigned here.
